youtube.title: Recording Mein Aapki Awaaz Alag Kyun Lagti Hai? 🎙️ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Aapne apni asli awaaz kabhi suni hi nahi hai. Jab aap bolte hain, to aawaz aapke kaanon tak do raston se pahunchti hai: hawa ke through, jaise baaki sab sunte hain, aur aapki skull ke through, jahan haddiyan vibrations ko seedha inner ear tak le jaati hain.

Haddi low notes ko sabse acchi tarah carry karti hai, isliye aapke sir ke andar aapki awaaz zyada gehri aur bhari lagti hai. Recording sirf hawa wali awaaz pakadti hai, gehra hissa gayab ho jaata hai. Matlab jis awaaz se aapko recording mein chidh hoti hai, wahi awaaz baaki sab ko sunai deti hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
